intro: Trying to find Arkansas scholarships with awards under a higher price-point ceiling usually means balancing budget fit, eligibility, and timing all at once. This filtered slice brings together USA scholarship listings tied to Arkansas where the posted awards stay below that cap, making it easier to compare options without sorting through larger national awards first. The programs below span themes such as education, STEM, arts, community, and medicine, with examples that also touch agriculture, communication, and business-related study paths. Requirements are not identical across these rows, but many listings appear to have lighter application signals and often no essay flag in the catalog data. Award amounts, residency details, and deadlines vary by listing, so applicants should read each row closely and verify final terms on the official source before they apply.
